# GitHub Copilot Instructions

This repository contains a Chinese game-development knowledge base.

Before answering repository questions:

1. Read `ai/instructions/core.md`.
2. Use `ai/scripts/search.py` and `ai/scripts/read_source.py` when available.
3. Cite source paths and line ranges.
4. Treat `ai/indexes/` as generated data and never edit it manually.
5. Warn when content status is `draft`, `outline`, or `stale`.
